name: Azeem Maqbool
title: Telecommunications Project Engineer
summary: Telecommunications engineer with 15+ years of international experience delivering mobile network and in-building coverage projects across the UAE, Oman and Pakistan. Experienced in IBC/IBS, active and passive DAS, 4G/5G, SRAN, commissioning, integration, site acceptance testing and technical troubleshooting. Based in Melbourne with Australian permanent residency and full work rights.
skills: 5G NR, LTE, WCDMA, GSM and SRAN
RSSI, RSRP, SINR and non-serving cell troubleshooting
equipment: Nokia AirScale; Huawei BTS 3900/5900, BBU, UMPT, UBBP, UBRI and RRUs; Huawei RTN 900 series and E-band; NEC microwave; Vertiv and Eltek.

services.title: In-building coverage & DAS
services.description: IBS surveys and design support, active and passive DAS deployment, site upgrades and expansions. Practical experience delivering coverage in airports, malls, hotels, healthcare and government facilities.

services.title: 4G / 5G network delivery
services.description: Installation, commissioning and integration of wireless equipment, SRAN rollouts and network swaps. Coordination across site activities, field teams and acceptance requirements.

services.title: Testing & troubleshooting
services.description: Site acceptance testing, single-site verification and RF performance troubleshooting. Working with NOC, RF and field teams on RSSI, RSRP, SINR, non-serving cells and commissioning faults.

services.title: Project & team coordination
services.description: BOM and BOQ preparation, materials coordination, subcontractor supervision and progress reporting. Hands-on oversight of quality, safety and the work needed to reach handover.

experience.title: Telecommunications Project Engineer
experience.project: du IBS · 5G, SRAN, SWAP and DAS deployment
bullets: Managed end-to-end wireless delivery across site acquisition, installation, commissioning, integration, testing and customer acceptance.
Delivered 16 passive SRAN/5G sites and one active 5G site with more than 100 pRRHs at Zayed International Airport, coordinating eight teams.
Supervised four subcontractor crews and coordinated quality, safety, materials, BOMs/BOQs, progress reporting and stakeholder requirements.
Resolved commissioning, IBS DAS and RF performance issues with NOC, RF and field teams.

experience.title: Telecommunications Engineer
bullets: Installed, commissioned and integrated Huawei 5900/3900 BBUs and RRUs for mobile network and IBS projects.
Troubleshot network configuration, commissioning scripts, RTN 900-series microwave links, E-band and transmission equipment.

experience.title: Implementation Team Lead
bullets: Prepared DAS plans and design proposals for GSM, WCDMA and LTE, supported by site surveys, coverage scans and walk-test reviews.
Supervised installation, commissioning and integration of Huawei BTS and RF equipment; coordinated logistics, subcontractors, customer ATPs and BSS support.

experience.title: Integration Engineer / IBS Designer
bullets: Led IBS design, site surveys and site acceptance testing for GSM, WCDMA and LTE networks.
Supervised Huawei BTS and RF installation, managed field teams and subcontractors, and maintained implementation databases and technical change requests.

experience.title: Support Engineer
bullets: Performed drive testing, post-processing, network audits, coverage analysis, benchmarking and parameter optimization.
Conducted single-site verification, voice and video testing, R99/HSDPA checks and cluster analysis.

experience.title: Project Coordinator
bullets: Coordinated site teams and communication between customers and technical teams, overseeing installation and commissioning of Huawei NodeB and microwave equipment.

experience.title: Telecom Implementation Engineer / Team Leader
experience.project: Telecommunications implementation and field team leadership
bullets: Worked on telecom implementation and led field teams for network delivery.

experience.title: Technical Support Engineer
bullets: Supported BTS installation, integration, commissioning and microwave link deployment.

experience.title: BSS Engineer
bullets: BSS engineering for the ZTE-China Mobile (Paktel) project.
